sentences.text:
Ms. Lalfakhawmi Ralte vs Union Of India & Ors on 29 January,
2019

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak

Ms. Lalfakhawmi Ralte
 Vs.
 Union of India & Ors.
 Mr. Arijit Chakraborty,
 Mr. Nilotpal Chowdhury,
 Mr. Prabir Bera .... For the petitioner.

Ms. Rajashree V. Kundalia ... for UOI.
 Mr. Somnath Ganguli,
 Ms. Manasi Mukherjee ... for respondent nos.2 & 3 The petitioner assails a seizure of goods made by the customs authorities under Section 110 of the Customs Act, 1962.
It appears from the records that, the petitioner applied under Section 110A of the Act of 1962 for provisional release.
Such an application is yet to be considered and finally decided upon.
According to the customs authorities, they are awaiting the decision of Food Safety and Standard Authority of India.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standard Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The seizure is in respect of areca nuts.
According to the customs authorities, the areca nuts are apparently, unfit for human consumption.

In such circumstances, it would appropriate to direct the customs authorities to consider and decide the application for provisional release made by the petitioner under Section 110A of the Act of 1962 within a fortnight from date.
Needless to say that, the authorities will afford a reasonable opportunity of hearing to the petitioner.
It is at liberty to hear such other parties and consult such documents as it deems appropriate.
It will pass a reasoned order, which it will communicate to the parties it has heard forthwith thereafter.
So far as the seizure of the goods is concerned, it would be appropriate to permit the parties to file affidavits.
